arguments.command:
cd /app/work && cat > razor.py <<'PYEOF'
import json, subprocess, sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/app/work')
import checker
cases = [
  {"epoch":1,"node_count":2,"edges":[{"tail":0,"head":1,"capacity":1023}],
   "commodities":[{"source":0,"target":1,"demand":1024,"paths":[[0]],"previous":[16]}],
   "failed_edges":[],"budget":98304},
  {"epoch":2,"node_count":2,"edges":[{"tail":0,"head":1,"capacity":1024}],
   "commodities":[{"source":0,"target":1,"demand":1024,"paths":[[0]],"previous":[16]}],
   "failed_edges":[],"budget":0},
  {"epoch":3,"node_count":2,"edges":[{"tail":0,"head":1,"capacity":512},
                                     {"tail":0,"head":1,"capacity":512}],
   "commodities":[{"source":0,"target":1,"demand":1024,"paths":[[0],[1]],"previous":[8,8]}],
   "failed_edges":[],"budget":0},
  {"epoch":4,"node_count":2,"edges":[{"tail":0,"head":1,"capacity":600},
                                     {"tail":0,"head":1,"capacity":600}],
   "commodities":[{"source":0,"target":1,"demand":1000,"paths":[[0],[1]],"previous":[16,0]}],
   "failed_edges":[],"budget":500},
  {"epoch":5,"node_count":2,"edges":[{"tail":0,"head":1,"capacity":600},
                                     {"tail":0,"head":1,"capacity":600}],
   "commodities":[{"source":0,"target":1,"demand":1000,"paths":[[0],[1]],"previous":[16,0]}],
   "failed_edges":[],"budget":499},
  {"epoch":6,"node_count":2,"edges":[{"tail":0,"head":1,"capacity":1024}],
   "commodities":[{"source":0,"target":1,"demand":1024,"paths":[[0]],"previous":[0]}],
   "failed_edges":[],"budget":0},
]
lines="\n".join(json.dumps(c) for c in cases)+"\n"
p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"/app/submission/planner.py"],input=lines.encode(),capture_output=True)
out=p.stdout.decode().splitlines()
print("stderr:",p.stderr.decode()[:400])
for c,o in zip(cases,out):
    r=json.loads(o)
    errs=checker.check(json.dumps(c), r)
    tag = r["status"]
    if tag=="optimal":
        extra="mlu=%r mig=%r" % (r["mlu"], r["migration"])
    else:
        extra="summaxcert=%g" % (max((abs(v) for v in r["certificate"]["inequality"]), default=0) +
                                 max((abs(v) for v in r["certificate"]["equality"]), default=0))
    print("%-10s epoch=%d %-34s errs=%s" % (tag, c["epoch"], extra, errs))
PYEOF
python razor.py
